scope: Fresh HN retrieval and model composition with retained other-source checkpoints, not a new full search run
titles: Eleven v4: Our most expressive text-to-speech AI model yet

model.target: Sentiment toward the named company in retrieved story titles
limitations: Human-labeled financial news, not HN comments or company health.
Entity strings are disjoint; ownership and aliases are not verified.
Mixed-partition articles are excluded; subset difficulty can differ.
Entity offsets and text are required; mention counts cannot give sentiment.
Financial-news model applied to retrieved HN titles; domain transfer is unvalidated.
Selected titles are not representative public sentiment or business performance.
Negative recall was 1/11; do not use for risk screening.
